Lee (AE): Customer wants a sealed on‑prem POC. Constraints: max 5GB per patch, quarterly install windows, signed artifacts, and rollback guarantee. Theyre also asking if sealed changes pricing.
Priya (SE): We can produce differential minibundles. Typical pipeline: full bundle -> produce delta with model+config diffs -> compress (lz4) -> sign. Deltas often <5GB but depends on model churn.
Jordan (Sales Eng): Pricing: sealed/private = Private SKU + platform fee. For POC we offer a 90d eval license; conversion triggers reserved capacity billing. Quarterly guaranteed patch windows require SOW addendum / higher support tier.
Lee (AE): If we need emergency hotfixes outside their quarterly window, how does that work?
Priya (SE): Emergency hotfix flow: produce emergency delta, courier or secure short‑range transfer, requires signoff by customer ops within their emergency exception window. Recommend canary node then full apply.
Maya (Security): Signing/attestation: bundles include SBOM + signature manifest. We can provide a re-sign tool for them to run inside HSM/KMS. Need to confirm FIPS requirement and attestation needs. Telemetry: off by default for sealed installs; we can provide offline CSV metrics exports.
Logistics (Ops): Physical courier options: encrypted USB in tamper-evident packaging + chain-of-custody form; add notarized manifest if required. Cross-border may add customs delays.
sign-bot: [signer] bundle rbundle-20250110-9b2c size 3.7GB sig:sig-v3.key Verify:
``nredwoodctl verify --bundle rbundle-20250110-9b2c --pubkey redwood_pub_v3.pem
```
Priya (SE): Rollback: keep previous full bundle on jumpbox; operator flow: redwoodctl restore --bundle <previous> && kubectl rollout restart deploy/redwood. We'll provide a 1‑page rollback checklist.
Lee (AE): Next steps: 1) ask customer to confirm FIPS/HSM, 2) pick quarterly patch dates + emergency exception policy, 3) confirm acceptance criteria (latency SLA, model pin). I'll schedule a 30m call.
Jordan (Sales Eng): I'll draft commercial note (eval license, courier costs, SOW patch SLA options).
Maya (Security): I'll prepare a pre‑read security checklist and sample signing manifest.
